definitions.explanation: Describing an attitude, action, or relationship characterized by opposition, hostility, or intent to harm.

examples.japanese: {敵対的|てきたいてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敵対的|てきたいてき}になっていった。
examples.english: The relationship between the two gradually became antagonistic.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{敵対的|てきたいてき}⟦{買収|ばいしゅう}→買収：04780_baishuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}けられ→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧、{防衛策|ぼうえいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じた→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧。
examples.english: The company was targeted by a hostile takeover and implemented defensive measures.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{敵対|てきたい}→敵対：12914_tekitai⟧ (hostility; antagonism) plus ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Used in both interpersonal and institutional contexts. Particularly common in business and international relations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}⟦{買収|ばいしゅう}→買収：04780_baishuu⟧: hostile takeover (business term)
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: hostile attitude
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: adversarial relationship
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: hostile act
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: hostile environment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{攻撃的|こうげきてき}→攻撃的：06243_kougekiteki⟧: aggressive — implies active attacks, while {敵対的|てきたいてき} can describe a stance of opposition without overt aggression
- {対立的|たいりつてき}: confrontational; opposing — focuses on standing in opposition rather than harboring hostility
- ⟦{排他的|はいたてき}→排他的：06388_haitateki⟧: exclusive; exclusionary — emphasizes shutting others out rather than active hostility
